title: This Crate Was Supposed To Fly
concept: A medicine crate that was supposed to fly stands for a UAA drone-delivery study that, per the Anchorage Daily News, grew into a cleaner record of rural grocery prices, cleaned by code an AI wrote and a person checks. The film sets that shelf-measured price beside the federal rule, which starts rural Alaska's food plan from an Anchorage price and adjusts by zone, gives the steady rule its best case, and ends on the open question with the crate parked and its rotors unfolding.

fingerprint.palette: first-light rose and glacier ice tundra, spruce shelves, kraft tags, steel beam with gold zone weights, mint code, pen red
fingerprint.metaphor: a kraft price tag on a string that started on a medicine crate, passes through a code comb and a red pen, and hangs beside a steel beam that prices rural Alaska from Anchorage

palette: first-light rose and glacier ice tundra, spruce shelves, kraft tags, steel beam with gold zone weights, mint code, pen red
divergence_note: 10-10 was a night parking lot under amber sodium lamps with a pole camera and colour-coded rule owners, 10-09 a dusk utility yard with a steel tank. This film opens on pink first-light tundra with a medicine crate, then moves through a warm store shelf, a mint code grid, a split Quebec desk, a flat Anchorage morning, a snowy bluff, a pale proof desk and a rope strung across the tundra. The hero is a soft object on a string passing between tools, where 10-10 was a faced machine on a pole. The colour code is by role (kraft the tag, mint the code, red the person, steel and gold the rule, green the signpost), and the argument is carried by one tag flipping between a measured face and a rule face.

angle.thesis: A study meant to fly medicine to rural Alaska turned into a cleaner record of what rural shelves charge, because AI wrote the tedious code and a person still checks it, and since the federal rule starts rural Alaska's food plan from an Anchorage price, measured rural prices are a different kind of evidence whose weight waits on publication and on USDA.
angle.falsifier: If the zone adjustments in the federal rule are already built from refreshed rural shelf checks, or if the cleaned rural prices once published match the Anchorage-plus-zone figures, the thesis is false. The claims file settles neither, so the film asks it and does not rule.
supporting_facts: c3 Jones: what it became is significantly more than transportation research
c4 AI-written code helped clean the price data
c5 Quebec researchers spent hundreds of hours by hand (per ADN)
c8 7 CFR 273.10 starts Alaska plans from Anchorage food prices, adjusted by zone
c9 Jones says the code still needs human oversight
angle.counterpoint: One city price plus fixed zones is stable and auditable, and scattered rural prices are noisy. The study is unpublished, USDA action is a hope, the 40 years is the Daily News's description, and the whole story rests on one outlet. Jones built the caution in himself by saying the code needs human oversight.

runner_ups.lost_because: Led with the rule being wrong-shaped, which the facts cannot support. Its closing question is kept.
Would have audited a researcher who only claimed a hope. Its distance-to-a-changed-benefit ledger is kept as the third act.

angle.valence: mixed (curious, leaning celebratory on the capability, open on the outcome)
angle.cross_challenge: The three proposals converged on the facts and were each stress-tested against their own strongest counterpoint. Synthesis challenge: is it a booster piece (no, c6 and c10 cap it), a scold (no, Jones is credited for building the caution in), a list (no, the chain is origin, accident, code, rule, test, open question).

treatment.winner: The Enthusiast's structure (the crate that never flew, rotors that become tags, the dotted hope) with the Explainer's rule beam with three zone weights, the Dramatist's calipers with a dotted readout.
treatment.why: All four pitches converged on a kraft price tag as the throughline and the Daily News attribution on every study claim. The Enthusiast gave the accident a wonder moment without claiming an outcome, the Explainer drew the rule's structure as a physical mechanism, and the Dramatist's calipers hold the ambivalence as two empty slots. The Comedian's raven gag was cut after the storyboard critic flagged it as a cultural misstep.
